request.notes: Keep every key event of the original fable, in order: the lion catches the mouse, the mouse asks to be let go and promises to help one day, the lion laughs and lets it go; later hunters leave a rope net, the lion is caught, the mouse hears him and gnaws the ropes, the lion is free. No hunters shown on screen. Aim for about 60 seconds. Character look lines should be concrete enough for an AI video model to keep the characters consistent from shot to shot.

script.title: The Lion and the Mouse
script.premise: A big lion learns a tiny friend can be a great help.

scenes.shot: Wide shot of bright savanna, slow pan left
scenes.see: A large lion lies curled on a warm rock, eyes closed, gentle breeze rustles grass

scenes.shot: Medium shot, camera follows mouse as it darts near lion, then pans to lion paw
scenes.see: A tiny brown mouse scurries across grass, the lion lifts a paw and gently catches it

scenes.shot: Close-up on lion and mouse, slight push in
scenes.see: The mouse trembles, the lion chuckles softly and opens his paw
scenes.narration: The lion laughs and releases the mouse
scenes.dialogue: Lion: I will let you go

scenes.shot: Wide shot, static camera as lion walks near bushes, rope net lies hidden
scenes.see: The lion steps onto a thin rope net, the ropes tighten around his paws

scenes.shot: Medium shot, camera tilts up to lion's face, then pans to grass
scenes.see: The lion growls low, a small mouse nearby lifts ears and looks toward the sound

scenes.shot: Close-up on mouse teeth, slow zoom out to show rope
scenes.see: The mouse nibbles the rope, fibers break and loosen

scenes.shot: Wide shot, camera pulls back as rope falls, lion stands free
scenes.see: The rope snaps, the lion steps out, the mouse hops nearby, both smile

scenes.shot: Medium shot, gentle pan right as lion nudges mouse
scenes.see: The lion gently nudges the mouse, they walk together across the grass

characters.name: Lion
characters.look: Large tawny lion, golden mane, soft brown eyes, calm expression

characters.name: Mouse
characters.look: Small brown mouse, bright eyes, twitching whiskers, tiny paws
